meta.title: The whole table
meta.description: Every flow in India's 2023-24 social accounting matrix as a heat-map and a table: who pays whom, how much, and how sure we are of each figure.

page.h1: The whole table: every flow in {year}
page.intro: The map draws India's economy as flows. Underneath it sits a single table, a social accounting matrix (SAM). Each row is an account that receives money and each column is an account that pays it, so the cell where a row meets a column is the money flowing from that column to that row in {year}. Every account's row total equals its column total: what comes in goes out.
page.units: Money is in rupees at current prices for the financial year {year}. One lakh crore is one trillion rupees.
page.gdpNote: Shares are of GDP in {year}. Gross flows can exceed GDP: GDP counts final output once, while this table also holds what firms buy from each other and the money that passes through financial markets.

heatmap.label: Heat-map of the social accounting matrix: {rows} receivers by {cols} payers
heatmap.help: Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter zooms into a block, Esc zooms out, T opens the table.
heatmap.helpPointer: Tap or click a cell to see it; double-click, or select a group name, to zoom into that block.
heatmap.legendNeg: Negative overall (for example subsidies, the Centre’s negative saving, inventory run-downs)
heatmap.legendScale: Log scale, the same for both colours: the faintest shade is the smallest flow in this view ({lo}), the strongest is the largest ({hi}). Equal steps in shade are equal multiples in size.
heatmap.legendScaleTiny: Log scale, the same for both colours: the faintest shade is the smallest flow in this view (less than {floor}), the strongest is the largest ({hi}). Equal steps in shade are equal multiples in size.
heatmap.noCanvas: The heat-map needs a browser that can draw on a canvas. The table below shows the same figures.
heatmap.emptyView: No money flows between these groups in this table. Zoom out to see the rest.
heatmap.noZoom: There is nothing more detailed to show for this cell.
